description: Applies one action to up to 100 conversations named in ids: resolve marks each Done, assign sets assignee_id (null takes it off), label adds labels_add and takes off labels_remove, priority sets priority, and read marks each read in Cosend. Each chat gets its own result, so one that is not found or that someone else is replying in is skipped with its reason while the rest go through. It acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it acts. Nothing is sent to any customer.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

name: bulk_update_conversations
title: Update many conversations
